design_concept.description: A fusion of an architect's drafting board and modern AI capabilities. The design uses a tactile 'Parchment' base rather than standard SaaS white, grounded by deep 'Ink' typography and monospaced technical elements. It feels like magic turning into mathematics.

headings.usage: Used exclusively for the greeting, project titles, and major page headers. Never use generic sans for these.

body.usage: Standard UI labels, buttons, and navigation.

mono.usage: Used for chat messages, builder logs, AI agent statuses, and tunnel URLs. This creates the 'technical blueprint' contrast.

borders.style: Always use a sharp 1px solid border (#cecac8) for cards, chat inputs, and the browser preview frame. Avoid soft large radii.

visual_enhancers.noise: Apply a very subtle SVG noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) to the #f6f3f1 background to enhance the parchment tactile feel.

buttons.primary: Solid #2a433d background, #ffffff text, rounded-sm, transition-transform hover:-translate-y-px.

chat_input.style: Large, prominent text area placed centrally on home. bg-white, 1px border #cecac8, shadow-md, padding p-4. Uses IBM Plex Mono for placeholder text.

preview_iframe.style: A 'browser window' component acting as the live preview. Top bar has bg-[#ece8e4] with 1px border-b #cecac8, containing a mock address bar showing the Tunnel URL, and a refresh icon.

home.structure: Central focus. Huge greeting text (Cormorant Garamond text-5xl), followed by the chat input block (max-w-3xl mx-auto). Below that, a Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6) for previous projects.

builder_view.structure: Strict h-screen layout. Top navigation (h-14). Below it, a flex/grid container: grid-cols-12. Left panel (col-span-5, 40%) for Chat and AI Agent Progress. Right panel (col-span-7, 60%) for the Live Preview and Logs.
builder_view.left_panel: Vertical flex, scrollable. Contains timeline (Manager -> Planner -> Coding -> Testing), chat bubbles (user right, AI left), and inline interactive cards (Implementation Plan approval, Q&A).
builder_view.right_panel: bg-[#ece8e4] p-4. Contains a large browser-like window for the iframe and a smaller toggleable bottom pane for Sandbox Build Logs.

admin_dashboard.structure: Dense grid layout (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8). Sidebar for navigation. Main area uses Shadcn tables for Data and Skills management. Tight spacing (gap-4) for data clarity.

motion.greeting: Typewriter or gentle fade-in-up effect on the rotating greeting.
motion.agent_progress: Use a 'Tracing Beam' or pulsing border on the active agent in the timeline to indicate current execution status.
motion.transitions: Fast, crisp transitions (150ms ease-out) for hover states. No bouncy spring animations; keep it professional and architectural.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #1c1917 text on #f6f3f1 background meets AAA standards. Action buttons (#2a433d) with white text meet AA.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2a433d] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#f6f3f1].

avatars.description: Elegant bald man in black suit, used for Admin/User profile picture
Confident young woman, alternative user avatar

abstract_graphics.description: Modern abstract architectural lines, perfect for empty state backgrounds or login screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI for standard components (Tables, Dropdowns, Inputs, Dialogs) but strip out the default Vercel aesthetic. Override radii to be sharp (rounded-sm at most) and borders to be #cecac8.
Implement the left/right 40/60 builder split explicitly using Tailwind Grid (col-span-5 and col-span-7) on large screens.
Ensure the rotating greeting changes text via an array of phrases using a useEffect on mount.
The AI Agent timeline should look like a vertical stepper using Phosphor or Lucide icons.
For the Q&A and Implementation Plan cards in the chat, use a distinct background (e.g. white vs parchment) and clear 'Approve' or 'Request Changes' buttons.
The Admin dashboard must isolate data securely and provide clear CRUD UI for the markdown skills files.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' design. Do not use standard centered, rounded, drop-shadowed SaaS layouts.
Embrace the 'Parchment' background. Do not apply full-screen gradients.
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) to let the typography breathe.
Never apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
Use Shadcn's components but aggressively style them to fit the earthy/architectural theme.
